summary.text: Amanda Beach-Burge is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 12, 2026 primary.
She was also the Democratic nominee for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Beach-Burge was born in Huntington, West Virginia, and graduated from Huntington High School.
Her career experience includes working as a manager, and she has been affiliated with the Cabell County Democratic Executive Committee.
Beach-Burge lost the November 5, 2024 general election for District 23 to incumbent Republican Evan Worrell, receiving 24.4 percent of the vote (1,673 votes) to Worrell's 75.6 percent.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong Huntingtonian and said her priorities included education funding and support for teachers, unions and workers' rights, and healthcare access.
